texts.preamble: Sri Nsk Crackers vs The District Revenue Officer And on 6 June, 2024 Author: G.R.Swaminathan Bench: G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.11664 of Before The Madurai Bench Of Madras High Court Dated: 06.06.2024 Coram The Honourable Mr.Justice G.R.Swaminathan W.P(MD)No.11664 of 2024 and W.M.P(MD)No.10410 of 2024 Sri Nsk Crackers, Represented by its Partner N.Sakthivel Rajan, Door No.61/R, Gandhi Road, Sivakasi Town, Sivakasi Taluk, Virudhunagar District. ... Petitio Vs. 1.The District Revenue Officer and Additional District Magistrate, Virudhunagar District, Virudhunagar. 2.The Special Tahsildar (Matches and Fireworks Investigation), Sivakasi, Virudhunagar District. 3.The Village Administrative Officer, V.Muthulingapuram Village, Virudhunagar Taluk, Virudhunagar District. ... Respond https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 1/6 Sri Nsk Crackers vs The District Revenue Officer And on 6 June, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/136189326/ 1 W.P(MD)No.1 Prayer:
texts.arguments: 2.The second respondent herein sealed the petition mentioned premises on the ground that the petitioner was found to manufacture crackers in violation of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India. 4.The learned Government Advocate however submitted that the authority resorted to the act of sealing only for the purpose of storing the seized goods. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would strongly plead that the manufacture of the crackers is not in contravention of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
texts.petitioner_arguments: 2.The second respondent herein sealed the petition mentioned premises on the ground that the petitioner was found to manufacture crackers in violation of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India. 4.The learned Government Advocate however submitted that the authority resorted to the act of sealing only for the purpose of storing the seized goods. https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 7.The learned counsel appearing for the petitioner would strongly plead that the manufacture of the crackers is not in contravention of the norms laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court of India.
